updates.title: First public ticker message
updates.text: Interrupted service: Puidoux - Vauderens and Lucens

updates.title: Interruption of rail traffic
updates.text: A fire broke out on a transformer at Palézieux station. The power supply to the overhead line has been cut, resulting in the suspension of services between Puidoux and Vauderens and between Puidoux and Lucens. We are doing everything we can to organise rail replacement buses and will keep you informed of delays and transport solutions as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding.

updates.title: Control centre (internal)
updates.text: First forecast: 18:00.

updates.title: Control centre (internal)
updates.text: 4 buses, 150 seats, from Palézieux to Lausanne, Puidoux, Vauderens and Romont. At the stations from 17:15.
changes: 4 Bus Intertours 150 places pour PALEZIEUX -LAUSANNE, PALEZIEUX-PUIDOUX, PALEZIEUX -VAUDERENS PALEZIEUX-ROMONT. En gare de départ pour 17h15.

updates.title: Additional information
updates.text: A technician from the overhead contact line is on his way to inspect the transformer and overhead contact line and take action to rectify the fault.

updates.title: Cause of the fire
updates.text: A bird landed on the line and caused a short circuit. The bird will need to be evacuated before technicians can inspect the facility and attempt to restore power.

updates.title: Rail replacement service
updates.text: There are buses on their way to turning-back stations, but there is not enough capacity. We recommend that our customers reschedule their journey or use an alternative route.

updates.title: Ticker updated
updates.text: Interrupted service: Puidoux - Vauderens and Lucens

updates.title: Provisional forecast
updates.text: The possibility of reactivating the track is currently being examined. The provisional forecast is set at 6.30pm.

updates.title: Control centre (internal)
updates.text: Power restored Puidoux – Vauderens and Palézieux – Moudon.
changes: Tension rétablie PUI - VD + PAL - MD

updates.text: The contact wire was extensively damaged in both tracks. First cautious forecast that a track will be operational again until 12 noon 2nd track: it will certainly go until the evening, until it can be made operational again.

updates.title: Cause of fault known
updates.text: At 05:40, an S8 with a defective current collector ran from Pfäffikon SZ towards Zurich main station. On the way into Richterswil station, this current collector damaged the contact line so badly that both tracks had to be closed.

updates.title: Remedial measures
updates.text: The train’s pantograph has now been secured so that it can be moved. The repair work on the damaged contact line can then begin.

updates.title: Passengers Wädenswil–Pfäffikon SZ and vice versa
updates.text: the S13 from Wädenswil to Biberbrugg with a connection to the Voralpenexpress or the S40 to Pfäffikon at minutes xx:10 and xx:34 respectively at minutes xx:42 and xx:02, the S40 or the Voralpenexpress will depart Pfäffikon SZ to Biberbrugg with a connection to the S13 to Wadenwil Connections can be found in the online timetable

updates.title: Remedial measures
